risks: No execution entry point by design: the preview cannot move, copy, rename or delete anything, and production file writing remains owned by OperationTrash/TransferSync and their gates.
No HTTP endpoint, no TianShu projection and no GatewayAuth permission-contract change; composition-root wiring needs the coordinator to assign module ownership.
Perceptual/near-duplicate detection, classification and preference ranking are not implemented and stay unavailable, so A11 is not claimed complete.
50k-asset complexity is argued as bounded (one length pass plus one strong hash per candidate, no pairwise comparison) but has no real-scale run, power-loss or cross-process recovery evidence.

Verification used a borrowed local .NET SDK 10.0.111 and the existing offline NuGet cache because this machine has no matching SDK and no outbound network; no system or global configuration was changed.
recommended_merge_order: 2. Handoff and delivery commit (docs and .codex records).
handoff_summary: Read-only exact-duplicate candidate analysis and reviewable curation preview for already registered libraries and explicitly isolated inbound sources. Exact byte duplicates require an identical complete strong hash; file names and sizes are never evidence; animations, re-encodings, revisions, sidecars and reparse points stay separate assets; unreachable or unreadable input is reported as an incomplete scan rather than as deletion. No execution entry point, no auto-cleanup, no shared contract, migration, root lock or release-gate change.

architecture_review.module: AssetIdentity only. Contracts, Domain, Application and Infrastructure each hold their own layer responsibilities; no other module was modified.
dependency_notes: Contracts <- Domain <- Application <- Infrastructure; Domain references no filesystem, database, network or provider type.

The dependency on ScanReconciliation internal layers was removed: the architecture gate forbids cross-module internal access and it formed the cycle assetidentity -> scanreconciliation -> assetidentity.
reused_existing_logic: RelativeAssetPath, LibraryId, CanonicalLibraryRoot, StorageAvailability and Sha256Digest used as published by their owning modules.
The shared read-only exclusion policy (thumbnail caches, temp files, .part/.partial) is mirrored so both walks hide the same names.
No scanner, file-operation engine, plan executor or write path was copied.
duplicated_logic: Only the read-only directory walk is implemented in this module, because depending on another module's internal discovery port is forbidden and would create a module cycle.
architecture_review.cross_module_access: None to internal layers. Only public Contracts-layer types from other modules are referenced.
architecture_tests: verify_repository architecture baseline passed with 0 issues after the module was placed under the mandated <Module>/<Layer> layout.
